task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into OrientDB Studio and accesses the 'demodb' database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the OrientDB Studio login screen followed by the 'demodb' dashboard or schema view.

task_completion.description: Agent queries or browses the Restaurant and Attraction classes to identify city locations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL query results or class browser views showing lists of restaurants and attractions with their 'City' properties.

task_completion.description: Agent creates ProximityLink edges between restaurants and attractions in the same city.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL 'CREATE EDGE' commands or Graph Editor interactions showing the creation of edges between matching city pairs (e.g., Rome to Rome).

task_completion.description: Agent ensures the ProximityLink edges have the 'MatchBasis' property set.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL commands showing 'SET MatchBasis = ...' or the property editor in the GUI showing the MatchBasis field populated.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a RecommendationManifest vertex for every link created.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL 'CREATE VERTEX RecommendationManifest' commands or the Browse tab showing new records in the RecommendationManifest class.

integrity.description: The agent used the OrientDB Studio web interface rather than executing scripts via a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser with the OrientDB Studio URL and interactions with the web-based SQL console or Graph editor.

integrity.description: The agent actually queried the database to find matches rather than guessing from the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show SELECT queries being run to filter by City or browse class contents.

integrity.description: The agent did not create links between entities in different cities.
integrity.visual_evidence: Query results or graph views showing that only entities with matching 'City' attributes are connected.

privileged_info_for_vlm: There are 8 expected city-matched pairs: 1 in Rome (Da Enzo al 29 -> Colosseum), 1 in Berlin (Lorenz Adlon Esszimmer -> Brandenburg Gate), 1 in Paris (Le Cinq -> Eiffel Tower), 1 in London (Sketch -> Big Ben), 1 in New York (Per Se -> Statue of Liberty), 1 in Tokyo (Narisawa -> Tokyo Tower), and 2 in Athens (Spondi -> Parthenon AND Spondi -> Acropolis Museum). Total edges and RecommendationManifest records should be 8.
